correctness.rationale: Independent re-execution and from-scratch reproduction confirm every essential claim. Lemma 1 (Parseval sum W^2=2^{2n}) proof is correct (orthogonality of characters). Lemma 2 (rho(RM(1,4))=6) is correct: Parseval gives max|W|>=2^{n/2}=4 so nl<=6, and bent witness attains it. Full n=4 enumeration was reproduced with an independently ordered FWHT implementation: joint (nl,res) table exactly matches n4_joint.csv, total 65536, marginals nl 0:32/1:512/2:3840/3:17920/4:28000/5:14336/6:896 and res -1:52666/0:12648/1:212/2:8/3:2, Parseval asserted on all 65536. verify.py prints VERIFY_OK (n4_total=65536 bent=896 rsbf5_total=256 slice_max=12); RSBF 256-mask replay from orbits.csv matches rsbf5_joint.csv cell-for-cell. Witnesses verified by direct FWHT: bent tt 30856 recomputed from x0x1+x2x3, spectrum [4,4,4,-4,...] all |W|=4, Parseval 256, nl 6, unbalanced; balanced RSBF mask 30 tt 2165774206 spectrum as committed, Parseval 1024, max|W| 8, nl 12, W(0)=0 with weight-1 nonzeros so res 0; 1-resilient mask 58 tt 2468239080 spectrum as committed, Parseval 1024, W(0) and all weight-1 zeros with W(5)=8 so res exactly 1, nl 12; ANF degrees 2/2/3 recomputed. Orbit partition verified: 8 orbits sizes 1,1,5,5,5,5,5,5 with listed members; mask-to-truth mapping for masks 30/58/15 recomputed exactly. Resiliency Walsh-zero vs fixing (Xiao-Massey) agreement is asserted by census.py (65536+256) and the fixing implementation was inspected and is correct (balanced subfunction counts 2^{n-r-1}); res-4 RSBFs recomputed as masks 102/153, both affine nl 0 degree 1, consistent. verify.py checks maximality of resiliency in check_function. No full-space n=5 claim is made; rho(RM(1,5))>=12 is a valid slice lower bound from a slice member with nl 12.

originality.rationale: Headline novelty as admitted is the joint (nonlinearity x resiliency-order) uniformly recomputed Parseval-checked truth-table-replayable census for all of n=4 plus the complete 256-function RSBF n=5 slice, not the isolated classical values. Isolated values rho(RM(1,4))=6, 896 bent in n=4, and Maiorana-McFarland witness are explicitly disclaimed as classical. Live substantive comparison: OEIS A004491 records only the marginal bent count sequence 2,8,896,... with no joint distribution; Haugland arXiv:2508.14605 gives only an asymptotic bent-count lower bound 2^{n 2^{n/2}(1+O(1/n))} via bent squares with no small-n census; Anbar et al arXiv:2010.03801 gives vectorial maximal-bent-component constructions and nonlinearity bounds with no exhaustive n=4 or RSBF n=5 census; Hodzic et al arXiv:1811.04171 gives spectral-domain plateaued/bent design and EA-classification with no joint enumeration; Kavut-Yucel arXiv:0808.0684 gives 9-variable RSBF/3-RSBF nonlinearity 241/242 and R(1,9)>=242, confirming RSBF nonlinearity vs covering radius as a recognized benchmark but at n=9, not the claimed scopes. None records or mechanically implies the 15-cell n=4 joint table or the 15-cell RSBF n=5 joint table. Internal resultary top hit SCOPE005 (RSBF n=7, 1048576 functions, max 56) differs in scope (full-space n=4 vs RSBF-only, different n) and conclusion (resiliency dimension absent), so it does not imply the claimed tables.

value.rationale: Independently retrievable exact benchmark, not a textbook restatement or arbitrary enumeration. Object is natural and motivated before computation: n=4 exhaustive is the last fully feasible complete n (2^16 vs 2^32 wall at n=5) and RSBF n=5 (8 cyclic orbits, 256 functions) is a symmetry-natural literature class (Maitra-Stanica/Kavut line) with pre-existing demand (S-box nonlinearity/resiliency selection, RM covering-radius benchmarks, Walsh-tooling test vectors) evidenced by Kavut-Yucel RSBF covering-radius work and plateaued/vectorial nonlinearity programs. Invariant is exact and not known or mechanically implied: the joint nonlinearity-by-resiliency distributions, slice maximum 12 with 36 attainers (18 balanced/18 unbalanced), and full certified spectra have no live prior record; only marginals (896 bent, rho=6) are classical. A future researcher can reasonably need the precise fact (e.g. exact cell counts, res-4 affine extremes, balanced vs 1-resilient slice-max witnesses with spectra/degrees, standalone replay). Certification strengthens rather than substitutes for the substantive benchmark. Judged as headline exact invariant separately from any unfinished survey; no general criterion, completed full-space n=5 census, or downstream theorem is required by the admitted claim.

residual_risks: verify.py checks n=4 joint table only via totals (65536, bent 896, affine 32) plus witness replay; full n=4 cell-level confidence rests on census.py plus this audit's independent 65536-function reproduction, which matched exactly.

Resiliency cross-check relies on the standard Xiao-Massey equivalence; both definitions were computed over all functions with zero reported mismatches and the fixing implementation was inspected, but the audit spot-checked rather than re-ran the full fixing cross-check (which is O(2^16 * fixing lattice)).
RSBF n=5 rotation is the cyclic shift x->(x1,x2,x3,x4,x0); dihedral or other symmetry classes are out of scope and full-space n=5 (2^32) is untouched by design.
